extensions/src/platform-scripture-editor/src/platform-scripture-editor.utils.ts line 1 at r1 (raw file):
Previously, katherinejensen00 wrote…
[Medium] The extension-host import boundary is documented but not enforced — and it's a hard-fail.
The header is accurate: a value import of a UI module into this host-reachable file crashes activation. I confirmed the exact mechanism — lucide-react/platform-bible-react aren't webpack-externalized, so they're bundled, but they call forwardRef/createContext at module-eval, which transitively emits require('react'); react is externalized and isn't on the host shim's allowlist (extension.service.ts:1328-1354), so it throws "Requiring other than papi is not allowed" and no editor opens. The whole safety net is prose, and PT-XXX-D..G will keep adding UI to this extension. Consider a no-restricted-imports rule (or an import-graph vitest test over main.ts's transitive deps) so this fails in CI instead of at runtime. The cheapest first step is #6 below.

Done.
